segment_registry.classification_basis: Official NSE Indices membership; unmatched active NSE securities use an Extended NSE label. Liquidity is never used as a market-cap proxy.

selection_gate_policy.purpose: Prioritize companies for BMS evidence work; never alter BMS scores or lifecycle.
selection_gate_policy.liquidity_reference: 20th percentile of official NIFTY Microcap 250, subject to a ₹5 crore absolute floor

peer_relative_strength_policy.method: Company blended 6-1 and 3-month momentum minus the median blended momentum of its peer group.
peer_relative_strength_policy.universe_peer_group: Official large-, mid-, or small-cap segment membership.
peer_relative_strength_policy.sector_peer_group: Official NSE Indices Industry label across the monitored universe.
